name: Kinder Morgan Texas Pipeline Expansion Project

values.SegmentName: Kinder Morgan Texas Pipeline Expansion Project

researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, row 1099: Kinder Morgan Texas Pipeline Expansion Project, expansion, completed, in service 2023, Texas, intrastate, 30 miles, 30 inch, 500 MMcf/d added, cost 180 million USD, serves Kimmeridge Texas Gas and other third parties, source listed as a Kinder Morgan press release. Not the Freer to Sinton line (67 mi, 42 in, EIA row 1094) and not the Webb County Extension (EIA row 1119, 158 million USD, 400 MMcf/d). Not an existing GEM row: no roster row for this Kinder Morgan Texas Pipeline system, so PipelineName is staged as the operator system name and needs a check against the ownership team naming. 30 miles is about 48 km, above the 25 km threshold. Only EIA was checked; the press release was not found and no second independent source was verified because the search tool hit a session limit. No state regulator filing (Texas Railroad Commission) was checked. EIA completed date is blank and the notes line in the queue saying July 2025 does not match the sheet, which gives 2023 as the in-service year. Start and end locations not found. Route not researched. Owner uses the existing Kinder Morgan Inc entity. Tier medium, single origin.
